behavior.local_task_reuse: One immutable selected TaskSet per controls/materialization/preflight routine; preserve malformed/empty-directory rejection before task or authority access. Reuse the same selected rows in the task loop.
behavior.passive_screen_reuse: collect_source_screen passes its already validated SourceScreen to its sole private _source caller; that helper derives a fresh record. The failed-source sibling also binds the TaskSet locally.
behavior.strict_boundaries: All artifact constructors, source/selection/hash checks, file/runtime/owner/publication checks and fresh NativeEvidence finishes stay unchanged.

hosted_verification: Pending exact published-source CI; no full-suite or hosted pass claimed by local checks.

independent_review.record: Retained parent-chat review; no separate review artifact written.
independent_review.scope: Exact two helper diffs, sole caller and failed-source sibling, immutability/fresh copies/evidence/failure-order invariants plus supplied-only four-method rerun.

limits: Measured 51-to-27 population scans and three-to-one declaration constructions are supplied-fixture work reductions, not a timing ratio or actual193-history speedup.
Native/report-byte preservation is checked within each synthetic source cut; source-bound report identities may change with declared host source.
No new raw/parsed cache, weaker validator, evidence-finishing bypass, owner replacement or source migration.
Hosted verification, actual retained-history compatibility, cleanup reconciliation and live clearance remain separate.

requirements: Existing policy admits exactly two profiles; do not silently widen it or relabel B owners as C.
Active B screen is bound to literal B helper sources. A fresh checked B one-action descriptor is an existing bounded option, not the unchanged trial command.
Closing B does not remove A/B provenance: a separately reviewed bounded versioned per-owner/profile relation is needed before C adoption; preserve earlier AB feedback bytes.
